Country: Canada
Partner: Homewise
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Homewise is a free, online service that connects Canadian homebuyers with mortgages
by comparing options from over 30 lenders to find the best rates and features for their
unique needs. To use it, you complete a quick online application, and then a personal
Homewise Advisor guides you through the process, providing unbiased advice and
handling administrative work. The service is free for customers, as Homewise earns a
commission from the lenders.
Why we recommend: Homewise simplifies the often overwhelming mortgage process by connecting Canadians with the best lenders and rates in one easy platform. Their team is dedicated to making home financing more transparent, personalized, and stress-free.
How it helps: Homewise helps newcomers navigate the often complex process of securing a mortgage in Canada, making homeownership more accessible. By comparing multiple lenders on your behalf, they save you both time and money while ensuring you find a mortgage that suits your unique financial situation. Their team provides guidance through every step, from application to approval, helping you understand your options and feel confident in your decisions. With Homewise’s support, you can approach buying a home with clarity and peace of mind, knowing you’re making the best choice for your future.
Link: https://my.thinkhomewise.com/p/smoothmigration

Country: Canada
Partner: Airalo e-SIM
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM marketplace, providing digital SIM (eSIM)
plans for travelers to access mobile data, and sometimes calls and texts, in over 200
countries and regions without needing a physical SIM card. To use Airalo, you download
the app, purchase a digital eSIM for your destination, install it on your compatible
device, and then connect to a mobile network upon arrival to get online.
Why we recommend: We recommend Airalo for its affordability, reliability, and convenience—offering seamless data access wherever you go. With Airalo’s eSIM technology, you can skip the hassle of physical SIM cards and avoid high roaming charges when traveling or moving abroad. Their plans are flexible and cover a wide range of destinations, making it easy to stay connected no matter where life takes you. Airalo is a trusted choice for newcomers and frequent travelers who want cost-effective and stress-free mobile data solutions.
How it helps: Airalo makes migration and travel easier by giving you instant, hassle-free mobile connectivity the moment you arrive in your new country. With their eSIM technology, you can skip the need for local SIM cards and avoid costly roaming charges, saving both time and money. Their wide range of global plans ensures you stay connected wherever you go, whether for work, family, or exploring your new surroundings. By providing reliable data access from day one, Airalo helps you settle in smoothly and stay connected without stress.
Link: https://airalo.pxf.io/7m4YGA

Country: Canada
Partner: National Bank of Canada
Category: Banking Services
Overview: National Bank of Canada (NBC) is a large, integrated financial group and one of
Canada's six systemically important banks, founded in 1859. It operates through four
business segments—Personal and Commercial Banking, Wealth
Management, Financial Markets, and U.S. Specialty Finance and International—to offer
a comprehensive range of services, including retail banking, investments, insurance,
credit, savings, and specialized corporate and institutional services in Canada and
abroad.
Why we recommend: National Bank of Canada is one of the country’s leading financial institutions, known for its stability, wide range of services, and commitment to supporting newcomers. They provide trusted banking solutions tailored to help you get settled quickly and securely.
How it helps: From opening your first Canadian bank account to setting up credit, savings, and everyday transactions, National Bank makes managing your finances simple. Their newcomer programs are designed to give you the tools and support you need to build a strong financial foundation in Canada.
Link: https://api.fintelconnect.com/t/l/63f6a452b85d5f001b482670

Country: Canada
Partner: Covermore
Category: Insurance
Overview: Covermore (or Cover-More) is a global travel insurance provider that offers protection
for travelers from unforeseen costs like medical emergencies, lost luggage, and trip
cancellations. It functions by offering various insurance plans that cover a range of
travel-related incidents, providing a financial safety net and access to 24/7 emergency
travel assistance services. The process involves purchasing a plan, and if a covered
event occurs, contacting the assistance center for help and then submitting a claim for
reimbursement or payment of expenses.
Why we recommend: Covermore is a trusted travel insurance provider with a strong reputation for reliability and comprehensive coverage. They have years of experience supporting travelers around the world, making them a dependable choice for peace of mind on any journey. Their wide range of policies is designed to protect against unexpected costs like medical emergencies, trip cancellations, or lost baggage. With Covermore, you can travel with confidence knowing you’re backed by a company that puts your safety and security first.
How it helps: Covermore helps newcomers and travelers protect themselves against unexpected costs, giving peace of mind during relocation or travel. Their comprehensive insurance plans cover everything from medical emergencies and trip cancellations to lost or delayed belongings. With flexible policies tailored to different needs, you can choose the coverage that fits your situation and budget. By providing reliable protection, Covermore allows you to focus on settling into your new home or enjoying your journey without unnecessary worry.
Link: https://fxo.co/1313391/covermore

Country: Canada
Partner: SquareOne
Category: Insurance
Overview: Square One Insurance is a Canadian digital insurance agency offering customizable
home, tenant, and car insurance policies through an online platform. Customers can get
quotes, purchase policies, and manage claims online, with the option for personalized
coverage to meet their specific needs, rather than paying for unnecessary protection.
Policies include high levels of standard coverage, and customers can add specialty
items, with options for expert assistance via phone or webchat.
Why we recommend: SquareOne offers modern, customizable insurance solutions that are designed to be simple, transparent, and affordable. Their digital-first approach makes it easy to get coverage quickly without the usual hassle, all from the comfort of your home. With flexible policies, you can choose exactly what you want covered and avoid paying for extras you don’t need. SquareOne’s focus on convenience and clarity makes it a great choice for newcomers who want straightforward protection for their home or belongings.
How it helps: Whether you need home, tenant, or condo insurance, SquareOne allows you to tailor your policy so you only pay for what you actually need. This flexibility ensures you’re fully protected while keeping costs manageable as you settle into your new home.
Link: https://imp.i146998.net/xk33Vdlemonade

Country: Canada
Partner: Pets Plus
Category: Insurance
Overview: Pets Plus Us offers pet insurance plans designed to provide financial protection against
unexpected veterinary costs from accidents and illnesses. To use the service, you select
a plan and pay a monthly premium. When your pet needs vet care, you pay your vet
directly and then submit a claim to Pets Plus Us for reimbursement based on your plan's
coverage, annual deductible, and coinsurance, or you may be able to have the vet paid
directly in some cases.
Why we recommend: Pets Plus is a trusted provider of pet insurance, offering flexible plans that make it easier to manage the costs of veterinary care. They’re known for straightforward policies and reliable support, helping pet owners protect their furry family members.
How it helps: With Pets Plus, you can worry less about unexpected vet bills and focus more on keeping your pet happy and healthy. Their coverage ensures your pet gets the care they need, from routine checkups to emergencies, without putting financial strain on you.
Link: https://www.petsplusus.com/partner/smoothmigration

Country: Canada
Partner: ExpatRide
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: ExpatRide provides specialized global car services, such as rentals and leases, for
expatriates moving to new countries, offering a streamlined experience by handling the
complexities of local credit, licensing, and billing for their corporate clients and
Relocation Management Companies (RMCs). They offer personalized solutions,
including professional chauffeur services and airport transfers, to support expatriates'
transportation needs worldwide, functioning as a global mobility partner.
Why we recommend: ExpatRide specializes in helping expats with reliable, tailored car solutions worldwide. They understand the unique challenges of relocating and provide services designed to make transportation simple from the moment you arrive. Whether you need a short-term rental, a long-term lease, or chauffeur services, ExpatRide offers flexible options to match your lifestyle. With their global reach and focus on expat needs, they make getting around in a new country stress-free and convenient.
How it helps: ExpatRide helps newcomers access reliable transportation quickly and conveniently, making settling into a new country much easier. They offer a range of tailored vehicle solutions, including short- and long-term rentals, leases, and chauffeur services, to suit different lifestyles and needs. Their global network and personalized approach ensure you get a vehicle that fits your requirements without unnecessary stress. By simplifying transportation, ExpatRide allows you to focus on your move and daily life with confidence and freedom.
Link: https://www.expatride.com/smooth-migration/

Country: Canada
Partner: Wise
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a financial technology company that
provides online money transfer services and a multi-currency account for
individuals and businesses to send, spend, and receive money
internationally at low fees and the mid-market exchange rate. Key features
include high-speed, low-fee international transfers, a debit card for
spending in different currencies, and the ability to hold balances in over 40
currencies.
Why we recommend: We recommend Wise for its transparency, speed, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional banks. With clear, upfront fees and real exchange rates, Wise ensures you always know exactly what you’re paying for, without hidden charges. Their platform is designed for fast and secure international transfers, making it easier to move money across borders. Whether you’re sending funds to family, paying for services, or managing finances in multiple countries, Wise offers a simple and affordable solution you can trust.
How it helps: Wise helps newcomers move money internationally with ease, making it simpler to manage expenses and support family abroad during relocation. Their platform offers fast and secure transfers at low, transparent fees, ensuring you get the best value for your money. With real exchange rates and no hidden charges, Wise removes the uncertainty often associated with international banking. This makes managing finances across countries straightforward, allowing you to focus on settling into your new home with confidence.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: Canada
Partner: Remitly
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Remitly is a digital remittance service that enables users to send money internationally
quickly, affordably, and securely, primarily, to family and friends. To use it, you create an
account on the Remitly website or mobile app, enter the recipient's details and desired
amount, select a delivery option like bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile money, and
pay for the transfer. Remitly guarantees on-time delivery or refunds your fees and uses
multiple security layers to protect transfers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Remitly for its fast transfers, multiple payout options, and reliable customer support. With Remitly, you can choose how your money is delivered—whether it’s direct to a bank account, as a cash pickup, or even delivered to a mobile wallet. Their secure platform ensures peace of mind, while competitive rates and speed make sending money abroad both affordable and convenient. For newcomers supporting family overseas, Remitly offers a trusted and flexible way to stay connected financially.
How it helps: Remitly helps newcomers easily send money to family or manage finances across borders, reducing stress during relocation. Their platform offers multiple delivery options, including bank deposits, cash pickups, and mobile wallets, providing flexibility to suit different needs. Transfers are fast, secure, and reliable, giving you peace of mind that your money will reach its destination safely. By simplifying international payments, Remitly allows you to focus on settling into your new country while staying connected financially with loved ones.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: Canada
Partner: XE
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Xe (xe.com) is a company that provides online currency conversion tools and
international money transfer services. You can use their website and app to convert
currencies at market rates, view historical charts and set rate alerts, and send money
directly to bank accounts or for cash pickup in other countries. To send money, you
register for an account, provide details of the recipient, confirm the payment amount,
choose a payment method (like a bank transfer or card), and process the transaction.
Why we recommend: We recommend XE for its reliability, transparent fees, and real-time currency tracking. Known worldwide as a trusted currency exchange and transfer service, XE makes moving money across borders simple and stress-free. Their platform provides live exchange rates, helping you make informed decisions and get the best value when sending or receiving funds. With secure transfers and a reputation for accuracy, XE is an excellent choice for newcomers managing international finances.
How it helps: XE helps newcomers manage cross-border finances efficiently, making it easier to pay bills, receive funds, or transfer money internationally. Their platform provides real-time exchange rates and transparent fees, ensuring you always know the true value of your transactions. With secure, reliable transfers, XE removes the stress and uncertainty often associated with moving money between countries. This allows newcomers to focus on settling into their new home while confidently handling their financial needs abroad.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: Canada
Partner: Sirelo (Experts in Moving)
Category: International Moving
Overview: Sirelo (Experts in Moving) is an independent online platform for the moving industry that helps people find
and compare removal companies by providing customer reviews and free quotes for
international and national moves. Users can post their experiences with moving
companies to create a comprehensive database of reviews and can request up to five
free quotes from movers in their area. Sirelo's goal is to make the moving process more
transparent for consumers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Experts in Moving for their experience, reliable service, and personalized approach to international relocations. With years of expertise, they understand the complexities of moving abroad and are committed to making the process as smooth as possible. Their tailored solutions cover every detail—from packing and shipping to customs clearance—ensuring your belongings arrive safely. By combining professionalism with a personal touch, Experts in Moving helps take the stress out of your relocation journey.
How it helps: Experts in Moving helps newcomers transport their belongings safely and efficiently, reducing stress during the moving process. Their experienced team handles every step, from packing and loading to customs clearance and delivery, ensuring your items arrive intact and on time. With personalized solutions tailored to your specific relocation needs, they make even complex international moves manageable. By taking care of the logistics, Experts in Moving allows you to focus on settling into your new home with peace of mind.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: Canada
Partner: Ownr
Category: Business Registration - New Category?
Overview: Ownr is an online platform that streamlines business incorporation and management for
entrepreneurs in Canada by guiding users through legal setup, providing tools for
compliance, and automating filings. It helps businesses register as sole proprietorships
or corporations, manage their corporate documents, handle government filings, and
create legal agreements. Ownr simplifies the process of becoming a separate legal
entity with limited liability, automating administrative tasks so businesses can focus on
growth.
Why we recommend: Ownr is a leading platform that makes starting and managing a business in Canada fast, affordable, and hassle-free. They’re backed by RBC and trusted by thousands of entrepreneurs who want to launch their business with confidence. Ownr simplifies every step of the process, from registering your business and creating legal documents to managing ongoing compliance requirements. By handling the administrative complexities, Ownr allows you to focus on growing your business and achieving your goals with peace of mind.
How it helps: From registering your business and creating legal documents to managing ongoing compliance, Ownr streamlines the entire process. This saves you time, reduces costs, and allows you to focus on growing your new venture instead of worrying about paperwork.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: Canada
Partner: Telus
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: TELUS is a major Canadian telecommunications and technology company that provides
wireless, wireline (internet, TV, phone), and digital IT services to consumers and
businesses. It works by operating networks for its services, utilizing a national fibre optic
network for high-speed internet, and offering wireless services through its mobile
technology. TELUS also has subsidiaries focused on health products and digital
services, allowing it to offer a wide range of solutions to its customers.
Why we recommend: TELUS is one of Canada’s top telecommunications providers, known for its reliable network, excellent customer service, and wide range of mobile and internet plans. They are a trusted choice for newcomers looking to get connected quickly.
How it helps: With TELUS, you can set up your phone, internet, and TV services seamlessly, ensuring you stay connected with loved ones and your new community. Their flexible plans make it easy to find an option that fits your lifestyle and budget.
Link: https://click.linksynergy.com/fs-bin/click?id=65QJ*oGZxWk&offerid=1187015.984&type=3&subid=0
